text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I wanted to share some<n>advice on
extracting the most<n>happiness out of your birthday...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: But, actually, let's put that stuff on<n>hold this time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's right, no feng shui—just a<n>present I got
simply because it made<n>me think of you. Here!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! N-no, this isn't it! Why do I<n>even have
something like this on<n>me?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hm? Huuuh?! ...Sorry, I think I forgot it<n>in my room.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's a hat I thought would look great<n>on you... I was
going to go "ta-dah!"<n>and make you really happy. I
can't<n>believe this!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! You don't have to worry<n>about that.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about how you did that<n>for me, well... it
makes me really<n>happy already.
